items.summary: An unauthenticated vulnerability, designated as CVE-2026-86591 with a critical CVSS score of 9.8, affects versions of the Botiga Pro WordPress plugin prior to 1.6.5. items.one_liner: CROSS-MAP is a new bidirectional framework that provides privacy-preserving LLM communication by decoupling input semantics from structural reasoning.
items.summary: Integrating Large Language Model APIs into privacy-sensitive workflows creates privacy risks as existing techniques leave semantic cues that allow text reconstruction. items.title: Decoding Guardrails: XAI-Guided Perturbation Analysis of Prompt Injection Detection
items.one_liner: XAI attribution analysis reveals that LLM guardrail classifiers rely on cumulative token contributions, which can be manipulated via saliency-guided perturbations to achieve jailbreaks.
items.summary: This study analyzes the internal decision logic of classifier-based LLM guardrails, such as Prompt Guard 2, using explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques including Vanilla Gradient and SHAP attributions. The researchers found that the classifier relies on the cumulative contribution of numerous tokens rather than isolated dominant keywords. However, saliency-guided synonym substitution and sentence-level paraphrasing can flip predictions and cause jailbreak bypasses while modifying only a moderate portion of the text. The findings demonstrate that explainability methods intended to enhance transparency can also be exploited to lower the cost of crafting adversarial attacks.
items.bottom_line: Defender transparency tools like SHAP and gradient attributions can be repurposed by attackers to efficiently construct jailbreak prompts that bypass classifier guardrails.

items.title: RBS-Attention: Radius-Bounded Sparse Prefill for Long-Context Large Language Models
items.one_liner: RBS-Attention uses radius-adaptive dual-branch selection to eliminate mean dilution during long-context LLM prefill, delivering substantial speedups without retraining.
items.summary: Researchers proposed RBS-Attention, a training-free sparse-prefill method designed to accelerate long-context large language model inference by addressing mean dilution in sparse block selection. The method combines a centroid base branch capturing average relevance with a rescue branch utilizing maximum key-block radius distribution to identify underestimation risks. Evaluated on H100 GPUs using models like Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct and Qwen3-32B, RBS-Attention achieved significant performance improvements, including a 20.65x standalone prefill-attention speedup and a 5.97x end-to-end time-to-first-token speedup at 128K context length while retaining high accuracy on benchmarks like RULER.

items.title: Calibrating Teacher--Student Discrepancy for On-Policy Distillation
items.one_liner: Calibrated On-Policy Distillation isolates teacher self-deviations during training, improving mathematical reasoning distillation across model scales.
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) techniques often transfer self-deviation errors from stronger teacher models to student models alongside true capability gains. To resolve this, the authors introduce Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (Cal-OPD), which estimates the teacher's self-deviation region using positive and negative privileged interventions. By filtering out teacher self-deviations and retaining only 52% to 65% of the original discrepancy signal, Cal-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD variants across model scales on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
items.bottom_line: Filtering out teacher self-deviations via privileged interventions ensures that student models learn actual reasoning capabilities rather than teacher artifacts.

claims.text: Cal-OPD retains only about 52--65% of the original teacher--student discrepancy as the optimization signal.
claims.support_span: while retaining only about 52--65% of the original teacher--student discrepancy as the optimization signal, Cal-OPD consistently outperforms standard OPD and its variants across model scales.

items.title: Learning Cardiac Features: ECG Biometrics Across Time and~Exercise
items.one_liner: A Siamese ResNet ECG biometric system demonstrates resilience to exercise stress and temporal drift, achieving low equal error rates on public benchmarks.
items.summary: This study evaluates electrocardiogram (ECG) biometrics under realistic conditions involving exercise-induced stress and cross-session temporal variability. items.title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
items.one_liner: Combining High-Level Synthesis abstractions with RTL refinement enables LLM agents to achieve a 2.6x speedup in chip design.
items.summary: Researchers evaluated whether large language model agents can design superior chips by using higher-level abstractions rather than directly writing register-transfer level (RTL) code. They compared Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, Post-Compiler HLS Refinement, and Post-HLS RTL Refinement, introducing AHRR (Agent-based HLS with RTL Refinement) which combines HLS design with RTL refinement. Using FPGAs across an 11-task benchmark suite, AHRR achieved a geometric-mean speedup of 2.6x over Direct RTL Design. Case studies demonstrated that High-Level Synthesis (HLS) distills design knowledge into manageable abstractions for agents, while subsequent RTL refinement captures low-level optimizations.
items.bottom_line: Leveraging higher-level abstractions through HLS combined with RTL refinement allows LLM agents to design better chips faster.

items.title: Scaling Discovery through Test-Time Communication
items.one_liner: Multi-agent LLM systems can achieve superior results through test-time communication, offering a scalable way to solve complex tasks that exceed single-agent capabilities.
items.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that multi-agent systems using test-time communication significantly outperform independent agents on complex tasks. By sharing breakthroughs via a shared directory, a team of k agents achieves success rates comparable to 4k independent agents, with performance gains compounding as the team scales. This approach proved effective for novel problem-solving in the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark and research tasks like polyomino packing and classifier compression. While compute-intensive, this collaborative framework consistently yields stronger results than isolated agents when clear feedback is available.
